Question: On which dates are interest payments made on the 4.750% Senior Notes due 2031?

Answer: The 4.750% Senior Notes due 2031 require semi-annual interest payments on March 15 and September 15 of each year [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 39; c0441], [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 77; c0844].
